hypothesis: Additional on-policy exposure to recorded low-speed stair stalls improves recovery without reward or actuator changes. Current evidence does not establish that stalls receive more reward than moving states.
single_factor: probability of recorded failure-state initialization within eligible upward 14x32 cm stair environments

source_states.physics_contacts: fresh solver state in Isaac; no MuJoCo warmstart transfer
source_states.geometry_requirement: same up_14x32 physical staircase and body-frame alignment; no placement on arbitrary generated stairs

common_task_preflight.critic: preserve saved training critic and height scan; replay evaluator with disabled critic is not a training task
common_task_preflight.terrain: retain common Flat/Rough/Stairs mixture in both arms; eligible fixed 14x32 stair subset identical in both arms
common_task_preflight.commands: external time-based velocity commands, identical distribution in both arms; initial failure-state command [0.3,0,0], then common timed schedule; zero/turn/reverse retained
common_task_preflight.rewards: all 17 nonzero terms from parent env.yaml unchanged
common_task_preflight.actuators: all gains, torque limits and action scales unchanged
common_task_preflight.stochastic_check: measure effective loaded exploration std and stochastic reset safety before PPO; do not silently shrink std
common_task_preflight.paired_control: both arms share any task adaptation; compare treatment against this control, not historical upstream returns
common_task_preflight.reset_test: physics-step safety, exact q/dq/previous-action restore, correct tile frame, no autoreset leakage

budget.extension: only after paired success and safety/retention gates; no automatic extension

evaluation.primary: worst upward-stair command-tracking success row on independent reset seeds
evaluation.regressions: no increase of unsafe; no loss of Flat/Rough/Stairs traversal, small commands, command transitions or continuous-zero performance
evaluation.uncertainty: paired differences and confidence intervals; 5 pp point estimate alone is insufficient
evaluation.state_bank: training states 7201/7203 are diagnostic secondary results only; create and freeze independent held-out failure states before training
evaluation.acceptance: pilot pass is not policy qualification or hardware approval

execution: not launched; complete common-task and stochastic reset preflight first; no new server job authorized by this plan
